TEAMSHARE_TOKEN.title: Your personal token
TEAMSHARE_TOKEN.description: The token your team lead sent you — it starts with tsm_ and identifies you specifically. Keep it private: whoever holds it can publish shares and record read receipts as you. Don't have one? Ask your lead to run /teamshare:invite <your-email>.
